name: Ra
body:
Often called High on the Horizon, Caretaker of the Sun, Brightest Light, and God of the Rising and Setting Sun, Ra rides in a solar barque, carrying the sun across the sky from east to west. As a sun deity, Ra is worshiped as a giver of life, provider of warmth, and facilitator of growth. In addition to assuring that the sun rises every day, Ra introduced the concept of truth or right-living; as long as individuals follow this principle, he continues to raise the sun each morning. In order to keep people on this proper path, Ra instituted the concept of sovereignty in which royals took responsibility for maintaining order, balance, and harmony among their subjects.

Ra appears as a human male with the head of a falcon. He is crowned with a sun disc encircled by a cobra, and he carries a staff and an ankh. Ra is worshiped by royalty, farmers, and individuals that count on the consistent cycle of the seasons for their livelihoods.

Solar

Granted Powers: You can use your magic to support life, make things grow, blind your opponents, light the way, and reprimand evildoers with flames of fire. A cleric with access to the sun domain can select this domain in its place.

Sunray (Sp)

You can hurl a sunray at a target within 30 feet. With a successful ranged touch attack, the sunray bursts upon impact, blinding the target for 1 round. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Sunflower Appendage (Sp)

At 8th level, as a standard action, you can ingest a seed which immediately grows into an arm-like appendage in the shape of a sunflower on your body. Once each round (including the round you conjured the sunflower appendage), you can use a swift action to pelt an adjacent creature with a barrage of sunflower seeds. The target must make a Reflex saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 your cleric level + your Wisdom modifier). The target takes an amount of piercing damage equal to your cleric level on a failed save, or equal to half your cleric level (round up) on a successful save. You retain your sunflower appendage for 1 minute. You can use this ability once per day at 8th level, and an additional time per day for every four levels beyond 8th.

Domain: 1st-flare burst, 2nd-blinding ray, 3rd-daylight, 4th-healing warmth, 5th-pillar of life, 6th-contagious flame, 7th-firebrand, 8thincendiary cloud, 9th-fiery body
